pick.name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
pick.what: Upload sources and get cited answers, audio/video overviews, reports
pick.why: Purpose-built source-grounded workspace with a usable free tier; nothing else matches its audio/video overviews.
pick.free_limits: Free (Standard): 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook; Plus 200/100; Pro 500/300; Ultra 500/500-600. Visible watermark on generated outputs: removal only on Google AI Pro/Ultra, and never for users residing in India, South Korea or Vietnam

best_free.name: Obsidian + Claude Code (local vault)
best_free.what: Local markdown vault that Claude Code can read and grep
best_free.why: Free for commercial use, fully local, no lock-in; the choice for confidential material.
best_free.free_limits: Free incl. commercial use; optional paid sync/publish

alts.name: Claude Projects
alts.what: Project knowledge plus chat over uploaded files
alts.why: Better reasoning and writing over the same pack; no audio overviews.
alts.free_limits: Within plan limits; free-plan availability unverified

alts.name: Perplexity Spaces
alts.what: Collections with files and web search
alts.why: Good when you want web plus your files together.
alts.free_limits: Consumer plans are marked 'for personal use only'; business use via Enterprise

decision: NotebookLM is the best source-grounded notebook for a general founder and has a free tier. Use a local vault plus Claude Code when sources are client-confidential or regulated.
details: Google's help page may call it 'Gemini Notebook'; rename unconfirmed.

region_notes.India: Outputs from Gemini Notebook carry a visible watermark for residents of India on every plan (also South Korea and Vietnam).

verify.note: The rename is confirmed: the NotebookLM help URL redirects to 'gemininotebook'. Watermark scope resolved; a region note is added because the watermark rule differs by country.
